Chronic pelvic pain can affect every part of daily life, and finding its cause often requires more than one specialist. This multidisciplinary clinic investigates the nature and origin of pelvic pain, including endometriosis, using diagnostic methods chosen according to each patient's symptoms, and then plans treatment based on current medical evidence. MedLuxLife arranges your evaluation at our partner hospital and supports you with preparation, records and travel.

Treatments and services

Detailed pain assessment

A structured consultation explores when, where and how the pain occurs, its intensity and its effect on work and daily life.

Symptom-based diagnostics

Diagnostic methods are selected to match each patient's symptoms in order to identify the cause of the pain.

Endometriosis evaluation

Assessment of endometriosis as a possible cause of pelvic pain, followed by individual treatment planning.

Multidisciplinary team

Women's health specialists work together with urology, gastroenterology, general surgery, physical therapy and psychiatry.

Individual treatment planning

Treatment is planned in line with current developments, with the aim of improving quality of life affected by pain.

Psychological wellbeing

Mood and emotional strain are considered as part of the overall assessment, with psychiatric input available where helpful.

Questions your consultation may cover

  • When the pain first started and how often it occurs
  • Where and when the pain appears, and whether it stays in one place
  • How long each episode lasts
  • Whether the pain has changed or spread over time
  • How intense the pain is on a scale of 1 to 10
  • Whether the pain limits your ability to work
  • Any link to the menstrual cycle, urination or sexual intercourse
  • How you would describe the pain (sharp, dull, aching)
  • The circumstances in which the pain begins
  • Any connection with eating, sleeping, sex or movement
  • Possible triggers such as movement, using the toilet, intercourse or medication
  • Anything that eases or worsens the pain
  • Any previous pelvic surgery
  • Any previous treatment for urinary tract or vaginal infections
  • Recent low mood, depression or feelings of hopelessness

Before you travel

To get a reliable medical opinion quickly, please prepare:

  • Recent medical reports and discharge summaries
  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports
  • Recent laboratory results
  • A list of your current medications and any allergies
  • A pain diary covering at least one menstrual cycle
  • Previous gynaecological ultrasound, MRI or surgical reports

How MedLuxLife supports you

1. Free consultation

Tell us your wishes – we answer your questions, explain the options and arrange an online consultation with a specialist in Türkiye. Medical documents go directly to the doctor, only on request.

2. Personal treatment plan

Our partner specialists prepare a treatment plan and an estimated timeline tailored to you.

3. Travel & treatment

We coordinate your appointments, hotel and airport transfers, so you can focus on your treatment.

4. Aftercare

We stay in touch after you return home and help with follow-up questions.
